Нордазепам C15H11ClN2O = 270.7. CAS — 1088-11-5. ATC — N05BA16. ATC Vet — QN05BA16. Profile Nordazepam is a long-acting benzodiazepine with the general properties of diazepam (p.986). It is the principal active metabo- lite of a number of benzodiazepines and has a half-life of 2 to 5 days. It is given in oral doses of up to 15 mg daily for the short- term treatment of anxiety disorders (p.952) and insomnia (p.957). Porphyria. Nordazepam is considered to be unsafe in patients with porphyria because it has been shown to be porphyrinogenic in animals or in-vitro systems.
